item.title: Porsche 718/2: From sports car to Formula One frontrunner
item.description: Motorsport Magazine looks back at some of the most significant single-seaters in Porsche history. This time: the Porsche 718/2, a car never intended for Formula One, yet one that took on the very best in 1961.

item.title: Banzai Legacy Lab: Culture in Motion
item.description: For Thomas Schlereth, his vehicles are living cultural treasures. At the Banzai Legacy Lab, he brings together sports cars, skateboards, art, and people, connecting the past with the present.

item.title: Twelve talented drivers compete for the status of Porsche Junior 2027
item.description: Twelve young racing drivers from ten countries are taking part in the selection process for the 2027 Porsche Junior Programme. The winner will receive financial support for the upcoming season in the Porsche Mobil 1 Supercup, as well as comprehensive support from Porsche Motorsport.

item.title: From Dependency to Sovereignty
item.description: Winning the new industrial race through speed, scale and strategic industry clusters.

item.title: Porsche Timepieces: A new era of timekeeping
item.description: At the heart of Switzerland’s legendary watchmaking triangle, Porsche Design has opened its new timepieces manufactory. Both the region and the building itself are steeped in centuries of horological tradition, while the state-of-the-art facility produces precision chronometers with the efficiency and discipline of Porsche’s manufacturing principles, creating exclusive, one-of-a-kind timepieces.

item.title: Royal duty: Historic Porsche 924 restored
item.description: The restoration by Porsche Centre Abu Dhabi and Al Ain brings an important piece of UAE automotive history back to life.

item.title: On patrol with the Black Mambas in South Africa
item.description: In the latest instalment of Porsche Newsroom’s Sunday Drives series, Black Mamba ranger Vongani Masingi explores South Africa’s Olifants West Nature Reserve, where a specially modified Porsche Cayenne supports the all-female anti-poaching unit’s daily work.

item.title: It Starts at the Top
item.description: In a crisis, top management looks to Human Resources. "Now HR needs to rethink its role," says expert Nicole Beger.

item.title: Porsche and La Marzocco unveil the 911 Carrera RS 2.7 Collection
item.description: Following their successful collaboration in 2024, Porsche and La Marzocco are joining forces once again to present the premium Linea Micra espresso machine and the Pico coffee grinder, inspired by the legendary Porsche 911 Carrera RS 2.7.

item.title: Olympian Tom Pidcock tackles the Nürburgring in his 911 GT3 RS
item.description: Professional cyclist and double Olympic gold medallist Tom Pidcock takes his pursuit of performance to the Nordschleife, joining Jörg Bergmeister for a track day with Manthey at the wheel of his Porsche 911 GT3 RS with Manthey Kit.

item.title: New operating concept with enhanced performance and an expanded digital ecosystem for the 911, Taycan, Panamera and Cayenne
item.description: Porsche is introducing a new generation of Porsche Communication Management (PCM) for the 911, Taycan, Panamera and Cayenne. A new hardware platform, Porsche Digital Interaction and an expanded digital ecosystem will deliver enhanced performance and a consistent user experience across multiple model lines.

item.title: When a passion for Porsche turns into friendship
item.description: For Porsche owner Kirk Gittens, who was diagnosed with a terminal illness in 2024, a visit to Zuffenhausen brought him face to face with some of his heroes. It was a friendship formed four years earlier that helped him get there.

item.title: Porsche congratulates Derek Bell on his 85th birthday
item.description: Derek Bell is one of the most successful racing drivers of his era. Five overall victories at Le Mans, world championship titles and numerous successes with the Porsche 956 and 962 prototypes mark a career that is closely linked to the most successful period in Porsche’s sports car history. Today, Bell turns 85.

item.title: Engineer at heart: Dr Michael Steiner is ending his tenure on the Executive Board of Porsche
item.description: For more than two decades, Dr Michael Steiner has shaped research and development at Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG – since 2016 as Member of the Executive Board, Research and Development, based at the Weissach Development Center. His highly successful tenure at the sports car manufacturer will end in May 2027.

item.title: New ‘Raceborn Moments’ episode: Two RS Spyders, countless memories
item.description: Twenty years on from the Porsche RS Spyder’s first full racing season, Porsche Heritage and Museum has brought together two cars from 2006 and 2008. Timo Bernhard and Sascha Maassen discuss the initial tests, races and the technical development of the LMP2 prototype, as well as a period that both still look back on fondly.

item.title: Andy Donaldson: From Macan to marathon in the Australian Outback
item.description: Extreme swimmer and world-record holder Andy Donaldson has conquered just about every challenge the open ocean can offer. Now he’s spending nine days behind the wheel of a fully electric Macan 4S, crossing Australia’s vast outback before taking on his next feat: swimming a crocodile-infested river.

item.title: Porsche AG systematically implements its strategic realignment: robust results and cashflow, outlook remains stable
item.description: Dr. Ing. h.c. F. Porsche AG resolutely continued its ‘Value over Volume’ strategy in the first nine months of 2026.

item.title: A lap of the Isle of Man with TT legend John McGuinness
item.description: In the latest instalment of the Porsche Newsroom’s Sunday Drives series, motorcycle road racing legend and Porsche 911 owner John McGuinness MBE takes us on a lap of his favourite place on earth.

item.title: Porsche Engineering and Porsche Digital combine their expertise
item.description: The international engineering services provider Porsche Engineering and the digital and software unit Porsche Digital will combine their expertise under the joint brand Porsche Technologies. This creates an integrated provider of holistic end-to-end technology solutions. The service offering is aimed at Porsche, the automotive industry, as well as other industrial and technology sectors.

item.title: Halfway Round the World in 78 Days
item.description: Le Mans, Gulfblue, Steve McQueen. Even in Tahiti, these names evoke dreams. That’s reason enough to send a specially configured 911 on a roughly 23,000-kilometer journey – quite possibly the longest sea voyage any Porsche has ever taken before its very first drive.
